facts.anchor: The first thing Elise sees is Aya’s face, floating close above her own.
facts.fact: Elise 醒来第一眼看到的是俯身贴近她的 Aya 的脸。

facts.anchor: By the time they arrive at the hospital, she’s at 223.
facts.fact: Elise 在出租车里靠计数熬时间，到医院时数到 223。

facts.anchor: Aya takes her through the emergency entrance to the waiting area
facts.fact: Aya 带 Elise 走急诊入口进候诊区，并替她交出身份卡和保险卡。

facts.anchor: you’re still pregnant. About eleven weeks since conception, or thirteen weeks after your last period.
facts.fact: 医生经 Aya 转述：Elise 仍怀孕，受孕约十一周，按末次月经算十三周。

facts.anchor: there’s only one more week left for you to elect for an abortion
facts.fact: 医生经 Aya 转述法律期限：只剩一周可选择堕胎，超过受孕十二周需两名医生评估并证明有风险。

facts.anchor: She handed him twenty euros for a fourteen-euro ride, and he gave her no change.
facts.fact: Catherine 付给司机二十欧元，车费十四欧元，司机没有找零。

facts.anchor: Catherine—he called her Cat; he was the only person to ever do that
facts.fact: Luke 是唯一叫 Catherine 为 Cat 的人。

facts.anchor: Elisabeth can still be anything, and it is all her choice.
facts.fact: Catherine 认为 Elisabeth 还什么都能成为，且全由她自己选择。
